en: Sepia-toned postcard showing an elegant multi‑storey historicist corner building with ornate façades and domed corner turrets. In front of it stands a tall obelisk‑style war memorial topped with an eagle. The street scene includes several people walking and a horse‑drawn cart. A shop sign on the ground floor reads "SINGER G. NAHMASCHINEN – ACT. GES." The printed caption at the bottom identifies the view as a new war monument in Graz.
